visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white top, addresses the camera in a brightly lit indoor home setting, expressing dissatisfaction with her current hair length. (2) She presents three hair styling tools to the camera: a flat pink comb, a small pink hair clip, and a pair of yellow-handled scissors. (3) The woman begins the haircutting process by measuring a section of hair on her forehead using three fingers and pinning back the rest. (4) Using the scissors, she carefully trims the middle section of her bangs, checking the length repeatedly. (5) She proceeds to cut the side sections of her bangs at an angle to create a tapered look, then shows a collection of cut hair strands in a white ceramic sink. (6) She uses a white hair straightener to curl and style the newly cut bangs, finishing with two small buns on her head. (7) A split-screen comparison shows her original look with a side part versus her new look with bangs. (8) The final scene is a POV shot where the woman leans in to talk to her husband, who remains out of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: POV: 臉偷偷改變老公看得出來嗎?. (2) [Subtitle]: 臭直男 ^_^. (3) [Subtitle]: 快被自己煩死. (4) [Slogan]: 準備工具 / 扁梳 / 夾子 / (兒子的)剪刀. (5) [Subtitle]: STEP.1 分出前額三指寬頭髮. (6) [Subtitle]: 先塞耳後 比較長的鬢角甩一下 就留短的就好. (7) [Subtitle]: STEP.2 剩下瀏海分三個區域 先剪中間區塊. (8) [Variety]: 小心鬥雞眼. (9) [Slogan]: 記得少量多次 一次剪太多就沒回頭路囉. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後像這種邊邊的 可以斜斜的像這樣 往斜下剪出漸層. (11) [Subtitle]: 最後這兩邊放下來 一樣三指寬區域 留下來的這個地方. (12) [Subtitle]: 也是一樣 就是斜斜的剪. (13) [Subtitle]: 最下面留你要的長度 像這樣我就覺得太長. (14) [Subtitle]: 希望我的髮型師 下次看到我的時候 不會覺得我亂剪. (15) [Variety]: 不專業示範. (16) [Slogan]: 一定要在廁所剪 ⬇️頭髮殘骸⬇️ 不然超可怕. (17) [Subtitle]: (電棒夾捲ing). (18) [Subtitle]: 旁邊這個鬚鬚剪得很好耶 看起來臉很小. (19) [Subtitle]: 我剛剛最後呢 又自己剪短了一點 大家覺得有成功嗎?. (20) [Subtitle]: 而且我想到 老公超想我留妹妹頭的 那時候我要留旁分 他有一點難過. (21) [Subtitle]: 於是等🐻下班到家 偷偷紀錄反應.... (22) [Subtitle]: 你覺得我現在這樣子 怎麼樣?. (23) [Subtitle]: 🐻: 妳今天有變. (24) [Subtitle]: 當然啊! 我剪了瀏海了!. (25) [Subtitle]: 🐻: 自己剪的?. (26) [Subtitle]: 對啊 我厲害吧~ 什麼我今天有變 你這句話 就只是一句 不會出錯的話.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice expressing playful frustration over a rhythmic, upbeat synth-pop BGM. (2) The female narrator's voice dominates, maintaining a high-pitched, excited tone as she explains her DIY hair-cutting plan. Digital click sound effects accentuate the appearance of text on screen. (3) As the haircut proceeds, the sound of scissors snipping is audible under the music, alongside a consistent conversational speech rate from the narrator. (4) The final segment transitions to a slightly different acoustic environment with more room tone, where a second, deeper male voice is heard responding to the female narrator's questions. A cartoon-style 'shock' sound effect plays when the haircut is revealed to the husband.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal vlog and beauty tutorial that documents the creator's impulsive decision to cut her own bangs at home. It combines instructional content with lifestyle storytelling, culminating in a humorous reveal to her husband to test his level of observation.
